test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in a sentence.

She __enunciated__ each word slowly and carefully.
solution:
The correct answer is "**Mispronounced**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us understand the meaning of the given and the marked words: 
 
 
• **"Enunciate" means to speak or pronounce words clearly and distinctly, so the opposite would be to mispronounce them**.

 
 
• Example: He set out to enunciate the basic principles of his system.
 
 
 
• Mispronounce (Option 3) means to pronounce a word incorrectly.
 
 
• Example: He repeatedly mispronounced the words.
 
 
 
 
 
• Thus, it is clear that the word "mispronounce" is the antonym of the word "enunciate."

Hence, **the correct answer is option 3**. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Chanted (Option 1) means to sing or recite in a monotonous tone.(गुणगान करना)
 
• Uttered (Option 2) means to say or speak aloud.(बोला)
 
• Murmured (Option 4) means to speak in a low, soft voice.(बड़बड़ाना)
